answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 35199 Country: India Title: I am a doctor. If I touch a female patient for extreme necessary whether I have to do ablution after that since I am in ablution state Question: I am a doctor. If I touch a female patient for extreme necessary whether I have to do ablution after that since I am in ablution state? Answer ID: 35199 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1895/1150/D=1432) Wudhu does not break by touching a female patient or by checking her pulse. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
